splunk_enterprise_security.name: Splunk Enterprise Security (ES)
splunk_enterprise_security.implementationFootprintNotes: ES requires data model acceleration for efficient correlation searches. Plan for additional storage overhead of 10-30% for accelerated data models. Requires dedicated search head or search head cluster for production workloads.
splunk_enterprise_security.storageConsiderations: Accelerated data models consume additional disk. Budget 15-25% overhead on top of raw indexed data for ES-accelerated models.
splunk_enterprise_security.cloudVsOnPremNotes: Splunk Cloud ES deployments are managed by Splunk. Customer-managed deployments require dedicated ES search head infrastructure and careful capacity planning for concurrent correlation searches.

splunk_soar.name: Splunk SOAR
splunk_soar.implementationFootprintNotes: SOAR primarily consumes notable events from ES. Direct data ingest is minimal. Focus is on playbook actions and external integrations.
splunk_soar.storageConsiderations: Minimal additional storage. SOAR stores playbook execution logs and case data.
splunk_soar.cloudVsOnPremNotes: Splunk SOAR Cloud is SaaS-managed. On-prem SOAR requires its own server infrastructure separate from Splunk platform.

itsi.name: Splunk IT Service Intelligence (ITSI)
itsi.implementationFootprintNotes: ITSI uses KPI searches and glass tables. Service definitions drive correlation. Plan for search capacity to support KPI base searches running at frequent intervals.
itsi.storageConsiderations: ITSI creates summary indexes for KPI data. Budget 5-10% additional storage for KPI summaries.
itsi.cloudVsOnPremNotes: ITSI is available on Splunk Cloud with managed infrastructure. On-prem requires dedicated search head capacity for KPI calculations.

splunk_observability.name: Splunk Observability Cloud
splunk_observability.implementationFootprintNotes: Observability Cloud is a separate SaaS platform. Data is sent via OTEL collectors, not through Splunk indexers. Integration with Splunk platform is via log observer connect.
splunk_observability.storageConsiderations: Metrics and traces are stored in Observability Cloud, not in Splunk indexes. Log data can be sent to both platforms.
splunk_observability.cloudVsOnPremNotes: Observability Cloud is SaaS-only. On-prem customers use OTEL collectors to send data to the cloud service.

splunk_uba.name: Splunk User Behavior Analytics (UBA)
splunk_uba.implementationFootprintNotes: UBA runs ML models on user behavior data. Requires sufficient history (30+ days) for baselining. Typically deployed as a separate instance that reads from Splunk indexes.
splunk_uba.storageConsiderations: UBA creates its own data store for ML models and anomaly data. Plan for additional storage on the UBA server.
splunk_uba.cloudVsOnPremNotes: UBA is available as an add-on. Splunk Cloud customers may have specific deployment requirements.
